2027-08-06.title: The Transfiguration of Our Lord
readings: His face shone like the sun
Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord?
The Lord will be your everlasting light
We were eyewitnesses of his majesty
O the depth of the riches and wisdom of God
This is my Son, my Chosen; listen to him
2027-08-06.verse: Then from the cloud came a voice that said, “This is my Son, my Chosen; listen to him!”

2027-08-08.title: First Sunday after the Transfiguration
readings: A lamp on the lampstand; the seed that grows by itself
A faithful priest I will raise up
Elijah on Carmel: the Lord, he is God
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you
Whatever is true, whatever is honourable
2027-08-08.verse: “Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said, “The first.”

2027-08-15.title: Shunoyo: the Assumption of Mary, Mother of God
readings: Here are my mother and my brothers
I will put enmity between you and the woman
At your right hand stands the queen
Let the earth open, that salvation may sprout
The tent of testimony; the Most High does not dwell in houses made by hands
The ark of the covenant; Christ entered the holy place
2027-08-15.verse: Then he said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” And from that hour the disciple took her into his own home.

2027-08-22.title: Third Sunday after the Transfiguration
readings: Ask, and it will be given you
Noah found favour in the sight of the Lord
Do not turn your face from the poor
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you
Scoffers will come in the last days
My grace is sufficient for you
God, be merciful to me, a sinner
2027-08-22.verse: But the tax collector, standing far off, would not even look up to heaven, but was beating his breast and saying, “God, be merciful to me, a sinner!”

2027-08-29.title: Fourth Sunday after the Transfiguration
readings: The mother of the sons of Zebedee
The Lord is the Levites' inheritance
Act faithfully, with your whole heart
Happy are those whose way is blameless
Serve one another with whatever gift each has received
He emptied himself, taking the form of a slave
The Son of Man came not to be served but to serve
2027-08-29.verse: For the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.

2027-08-01.title: Eleventh Sunday after Pentecost · Sunday School Day
readings: If your brother listens, you have regained him
The sun of righteousness shall rise
Do not hesitate to visit the sick
God is a God not of disorder but of peace
Jesus sends out the Twelve two by two
2027-08-01.verse: He will turn the hearts of parents to their children and the hearts of children to their parents.

kidsaint: Mort Shmuni and her seven sons (1 August)
